matches.rationale: The evidence describes leadership and transformation work but says nothing about hands-on coding in Go or Terraform or running Kubernetes clusters.
Owning incident management for an engineering organization is loosely related to on-call, but the evidence does not show personal participation in a rotation.
The candidate launched an internal developer platform and has led organizations of up to 320 people as a manager of managers, well beyond a six-person team.
The evidence does not mention reviewing pull requests or any daily code review.
The candidate owned technology operations and worked in cloud infrastructure, but the evidence never mentions AWS or end-to-end infrastructure ownership.
The evidence does not mention production experience with Kubernetes, Go or service meshes.
